Commercial cleaning · Lowell, MA

Commercial cleaning for stores, clinics, gyms and buildings

Janitorial and deep cleaning for commercial spaces within 25 miles of Lowell, MA and southern New Hampshire, with floor care included.

Get a free quote Call (954) 245-1566

From retail stores to clinics, gyms and warehouses, we build a cleaning program around your hours, traffic and industry requirements. You get a consistent crew, clear communication and a space that is always ready for customers.

Our floor care team strips, waxes, scrubs and burnishes VCT, vinyl, tile and concrete floors so your high-traffic areas stay safe and shiny all year.

What's included

  • Janitorial service on a daily, weekly or custom schedule
  • Lobbies, hallways, stairwells and common areas
  • Restrooms and locker rooms sanitized and restocked
  • Floor stripping, waxing, scrubbing and burnishing
  • Carpet extraction and tile and grout cleaning
  • Post-construction and move-in/move-out cleaning

Frequently asked questions

Do you offer one-time deep cleans?

Yes. Besides recurring contracts we do one-time deep cleans, post-construction cleanups and floor restorations.

Are you insured?

Yes. SGML Clean Solutions is insured and our crew is trained in commercial cleaning and floor care.

Can you work nights and weekends?

Yes. We schedule around your business hours so cleaning never gets in the way of your customers.
